news.title: OpenAI co-founder Andrej Karpathy joins Anthropic’s pre-training team
news.description: Andrej Karpathy has joined Anthropic to work on pre-training. He previously co-founded and worked at OpenAI and led computer vision and AI at Tesla.

news.title: SandboxAQ brings its drug discovery models to Claude — no PhD in computing required
news.description: Other venture-backed companies like Chai Discovery and Isomorphic Labs have raced to build better models. SandboxAQ is betting that access is the bigger obstacle and that Claude solves it.

news.title: Elon Musk has lost his lawsuit against Sam Altman and OpenAI
news.description: Elon Musk's claim that he was mistreated by his OpenAI co-founders failed after nine California jurors decided in a unanimous verdict that his lawsuits had been filed too late.

news.title: Zoe Kleinman: Why the AI industry is the real winner of the Musk-Altman trial
news.description: The trial in Oakland, California has helped lift the veil on the AI sector - and the huge egos of the men at the heart of it.

news.title: Satellites and AI used to track UK hedgehogs in bid to slow decline
news.description: Researchers hope the project will also help to identify barriers preventing hedgehogs from finding food and mates in the wild.

news.title: Musk loses OpenAI court battle after jury finds he waited too long to sue
news.description: Jurors spent weeks hearing about Musk's claim that Altman had "stolen a charity."

news.title: Former OpenAI Staffers Warn That xAI’s Poor Safety Record Could Complicate SpaceX’s IPO
news.description: The ex-employees, who cofounded a new AI watchdog group, say investors deserve more information about xAI’s safety practices before SpaceX goes public.
